comment: What highlighting needs in a native image, carried by this jar so an application that names HighlightStarter inherits it
and writes none of its own (vexelray-framework docs/TODO.md, ruled 2026-11-16: each jar carries its own metadata).
The bundled grammars, read by name through Class.getResource. A grammar an application adds is its own resource and its
Every jcodings tables/*.bin: joni loads a table by name the first time a pattern needs that character class, so a trace
lists only the tables one run happened to load, and a grammar a run never opened would fail in the next.
TM4E deep-copies a grammar through ObjectCloner, which finds each Raw* map's and list's clone() by Class.getMethod and,
when that finds nothing, copies into a plain HashMap or ArrayList, so the grammar is no longer an IRawGrammar.
Raw* inherit that public clone() from java.util.HashMap and ArrayList, so registering those two methods is enough.
Never register the Raw* classes themselves: TM4E's jar is signed, and that drags its X509 certificates into the image
No native-image.properties: nothing here binds native code, so there is no flag to carry.
